name: Good Morning Cruel City
source:
The City is a cruel place governed by greedy corporate overlords with money and fear where the wealthy live in upper level utopia while people below is drowned in crime and consumerism.

You are a Fixer, someone with a role that enables these crime by bringing together shady people to do shady jobs for a bit of cash while avoiding the existential dread of working 9 to 5 daily.

You woke up this morning thinking it'll be another usual day where you meet Ethel, your client for the day, to snatch a mysterious object from people you normally wouldn't want to mess with.

But little did you know, this job would brush your elbow with something beyond the stars...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2709990/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这座城市是一个残酷的地方，由贪婪的企业霸主统治，他们拥有金钱和恐惧，富人生活在上层乌托邦，而下层人民则淹没在犯罪和消费主义之中。

你是一名“修理者”，你的角色是通过召集不正当的人来从事不正当的工作来赚取一点现金，同时避免每天朝九晚五的工作带来的生存恐惧，从而促成这些犯罪。

今天早上你醒来，以为这又是平常的一天，你会遇到今天的客户埃塞尔，从你通常不想惹麻烦的人手中抢走一件神秘的物品。

但你几乎不知道，这份工作会让你的肘部接触到超越星星的东西……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2709990/]Steam[/url]]
